regions.today: Mostly cloudy and dry today with only a few isolated showers. Highs of 18 to 21 degrees with light southerly or variable winds.
regions.tonight: It will be largely cloudy tonight with some patchy mist and fog developing. Isolated drizzle is possible, but most places will stay dry. Mild and humid with lows of 13 to 16 degrees, with light to moderate southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start dry with some sunny spells, but it will become cloudy with spells of showery rain moving across the region through the day. The rain will be heavy at times. Warm and humid with highs of 18 to 23 degrees, with light to moderate southerly winds at first, increasing moderate to fresh through the day.
regions.solar_uv: Generally low, but moderate in any clear spells.
